newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends down on funds, hedges, sell stops.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends down on funds, hedges, sell stops.

text.p: WCE canola ended down on fund selling, hedges and commission sell stops, traders said.

"Funds sold early in the July, there were light hedges and we hit commission sell stops at $376.50 in the Nov with Cargill buying Nov and Jan scale down and RBC-DS selling," a trader said. July WCE futures crush margin rose to +0.34 Monday from -0.26 Friday. July-Aug spread at $1. Volume was 821 lots, or 16,420 tonnes, with 160 hedge lots.
July canola fell $0.60 to $402.10, November down $2.40 to $374.90. July flax lost $0.40 to $333 as commercials sold to RBC-DS. UGG cancelled its November offers. Oats didn't trade.
July western barley lost $0.40 to $135.10 on hedge selling, October fell $0.30 to $135.30. July-Oct spread at $0.10. Volume was 400 lots.

July feed wheat was unchanged at $159.10 with PCTS a late seller, October lost $0.20 to $160.30 with Alberta Wheat Pool buying both contracts and UGG the best seller of October, traders said. Volume was 107 lots.
UGG sold 25 October feed pea contracts unchanged at US$186.
(All prices in Canadian dollars/tonne except oats, peas).
